label: JZ Mock D · Paper 2 · Question 10
knowledgePattern: Count functions equal to their own inverse by disjoint pairs
solution:
If f(a)=b, then f(b)=a follows from f(f(a))=a. Thus an element is either fixed, or belongs to a two-element swap. Longer cycles are impossible.

With no swaps there is one function. With one swap, choose its two members in six ways; the other two members are fixed. With two swaps, choose the partner of 1 in three ways, after which the other pair is forced.

The total is 1+6+3=10. Answer E.

hints.body: Suppose one input is sent to another. Apply the given identity to determine what must happen to that image next.
hints.recap: A functional identity can be used at every permitted input, including an output that belongs to the domain.
hints.pitfall: The output assignments cannot be chosen independently.
